title: Redis: scale-out add a 4th shard replica pair
description: Adds a new shard (or a replica to an existing shard) via `nexus scale-out add redis`. Clones a new VM from the oltp-node template, installs redis-server, joins the cluster, reshards slots. STUBBED in v0.6.0; demo will fail with a clear 'lands in 0.G.1.x' message until the substantive add-node logic ships.

observe.what: affected nodes table: 1 new node (redis-7 or similar); outcome=ok; duration in seconds
shard 1 now lists an extra replica

whatProves: Redis Cluster can grow horizontally via `redis-cli --cluster add-node` + reshard. (Stubbed in v0.6.0; lands in 0.G.1.x.)
